issues.title: WP3 stale-owner tests leave private SQLite brokers open before fixture removal
issues.evidence: Real Windows WP3 41/43; two EPERM temp-directory cleanup failures after fencing assertions passed.
issues.rootCause: RuntimeStateStore.close() does not own/close the private SQLiteBroker created by direct RuntimeOwnership; stale owner test released only mutex.
issues.fix: Use ownership release with releaseLease=false for stale owner, release current owner, then bounded Windows directory cleanup.
issues.verification: Direct dual-owner private-broker closure and directory removal 1/1 PASS; full Windows WP3 pending.

issues.title: Backend startup failure does not preempt blocked credential FD5 write
issues.evidence: Real Windows WP4 194/195; A12/A14/A20/A21 CREDENTIAL_IPC_WRITE_TIMEOUT and three post-test unhandled Backend startup failed rejections.
issues.rootCause: CredentialIpcHost write deadline was independent from BackendProcessHost startup generation; startup-failed, child exit, stop and restart did not abort the pending write/promise graph.
issues.fix: Per-start AbortController propagated to FD5, hydration, READY and handshake waits; abort on startup-failed/error/exit/stop/restart; attach terminal catch handlers and remove listeners on settle.
issues.verification: Targeted startup-failure and stop cancellation 4/4 PASS; full Windows WP4 pending.

issues.title: WP5 mutation harness misclassifies Windows Node test failures as harness errors
issues.evidence: Real Windows matrix: total 24, killed 5, survived 0, harnessError 19; Node 24 spec reporter emitted ✖, fail N and failing tests.
issues.rootCause: Classifier recognized TAP not ok and JSON FAIL only; it did not force TAP or recognize spec reporter failure markers.
issues.fix: Force --test-reporter=tap, support TAP/spec/JSON patterns, persist per-mutant command/exit/log hash, and emit live progress.
issues.verification: 24 isolated mutants independently KILLED, 0 survived, 0 harness error; one uninterrupted Windows matrix pending.
